title: A Steel Ship Broke in Half While Sitting at Its Dock

scenes.text: A steel ship split in half while sitting still at a dock.
It was January sixteenth, 1943, in Portland, Oregon.
The weather was calm, and the ship had just come back from sea trials.
Then it cracked with a bang that people heard a mile away.
The cold had made the cheap steel brittle, and a crack ran straight through the hull.
Historians count nineteen Liberty ships that split in two without warning.

description:
A steel ship split in half while sitting still at a dock.
The tanker Schenectady cracked in calm weather on January 16, 1943. Brittle steel was to blame, and historians count 19 Liberty ships that split in two the same way.
Would you have trusted that steel?
